SKIN. [46] [Med.]
Great yellowness of skin.
Intense and incessant itching, fugitive, < towards night, sometimes confined to left side.
Itching all over body, most on back, vagina and labia, and < thinking of it.
Intense itching all over body, would scratch till it bled, but no relief ; no visible eruption.
Pricking sensation all over body.
Red spots itching when scratched and on undressing at night, on limbs, particularly from knees up, on forearms and around waist.
Copper colored spots (syphilitic) remaining after eruptions, turn yellow brown and detach in scales, leaving skin clear and free.
Small, pedunculated warts, with pin heads like small button mushrooms on various parts of body and thighs.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Med.]
Stunted in growth.
Suitable for grey eyes.
Baby, æt. 7 months, after summer complaint ; diarrhœa.
Child, æt. 15 months ; diarrhœa.
Man, æt. 20, gonorrhœa nine months ago, used injections eight months ; gonorrhœal rheumatism.
A maiden lady, no suspicion of sycotic poisoning, a long line of ancestors had rheumatism and gout ; chronic rheumatism.
Man, æt. 60 ; sequela of rheumatism.
Man, æt. 60, suffering six months ; rheumatism.
Woman, æt. 89 ; abscess of liver.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Med.]
Antidote : Ipec. for dry cough.
Compatible : Sulphur, especially when stool drives out of bed.
Compare : Picric ac., inability to walk right ; Camphor and Secale, collapse, skin cold, yet throws off all covers ; Veratr., collapse with cold sweat ; Syphilinum, reverse aggravation, i. e., from sunset to daylight.
